name: merlin-mcp

scripts.build:dashboard: npm --prefix dashboard ci && npm --prefix dashboard run build
scripts.dashboard: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:node && node --env-file=merlin.env dist/node.js

description: Read-only MCP server for Merlin (SRCE Moodle): grades, deadlines, files and messages for AI agents, with phone-approved sends

MOODLE_TOKEN.description: Your Merlin web-service token. Get it with `node scripts/get-token.mjs` (README, "Getting your token").

MCP_BEARER.description: A long random secret that opens /mcp for your AI client. Make one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

API_BEARER.description: A different long random secret for /api/* (scripts and automation).

DASHBOARD_KEY.description: Optional: a long random secret that opens only the web dashboard at /dashboard/#key=<it>.

APPROVALS.description: Storage for message sends waiting for your phone approval. Nothing to set.
